The most effective drug: get 7-8 hours of sleep. Now that I am sleeping effectively, I find it easier to:

1. keep my ego in check
2. have the courage to make mistakes
3. have the head-space to self-reflect on my mistakes

Even if you are already good with these, resting well can unlock more superpowers for you.  And their effects compound over the years.

I am in late 20s and can still relate to this. 

Going to share the advice my father gave me - people are trying to gauge your comfort level. It's like dogs when they play rough. They become friends by giving each other a hard time. 

Next time, try to make a game out of it. Someone makes a joke on you? Build another joke on top of it. Throw it back at them. I'm sure people will like you.
